title: Demon Slayer’s Success Continues to Be a Problem for the Anime Industry
content: The Demon Slayer franchise started a chain of events that is negatively affecting the anime industry in many ways, and most of them are bad. Demon Slayer became one of the first anime to produce a movie that adapted canon events from its original source material.
author: ComicBook

title: 5 2010s Anime Classics That Still Hit Today
content: The 2010s were filled with a lot of brief, but impactful anime series. A lot of modern notable hits got their start in the 2010s, but some of the most notable ones from the decade were anime that were only given 24 episodes or less.

title: New Solo Leveling Live-Action Series Just Took a Promising Step Closer to Release
content: Although Solo Leveling has remained quiet for a while, with no official release dates announced for any of its projects, the franchise’s live-action series has just taken a promising step closer to release.

title: Super Dragon Ball Heroes Proves Even The Weakest Saiyan Form Is Powerful
content: Base form used to mean low-level power in the Dragon Ball universe, but with recent content, some fighters are changing the narrative surrounding the term. It started with Dragon Ball Super: Broly , where the Legendary Super Saiyan continued to display obscene levels of power without advancing to his next form .

title: 'Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen' Unveils Additional Cast
content: The official website for the Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon no Taki-hen ( Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc ) television anime unveiled additional cast members on Saturday. The first part of the second season adapting Yura Urushibara 's action fantasy manga premiered on October 2 at 11.30 p.m.

title: Solo Leveling Studio’s Next Big Anime Confirms Early Crunchyroll Premiere With New Event
content: Bless is the most anticipated anime by A-1 Pictures, the studio behind Solo Leveling , and it’s all set for its early premiere this year. While 2026 is approaching its end, the anime industry is getting ready for its exciting new releases in 2027. Bless is one of the most anticipated anime of the Winter 2027 lineup.

title: Duel Masters LOST Anime Gets 5th Part
